name: Pumpkin Eater
source: A wealthy family. The young son is dead, hit by a car driven by his father. His head was literally crushed. His mother, refusing his death, replaced his head with a pumpkin from the garden and continues to take care of him, claiming he is still alive. Concerned about appearances, his father pretends that nothing has happened. And the family sinks slowly into madness as the son's body decomposes...
translation: 一个富裕的家庭。年幼的儿子死了，被父亲驾驶的汽车撞死，头颅彻底碾碎。母亲拒绝接受他的死亡，用花园里摘来的南瓜替代他的头，继续照料他，坚称他还活着。为了维护体面，父亲假装什么也没发生。随着儿子的尸体逐渐腐烂，这个家庭也缓缓陷入疯狂……
